name: makato-suite
description: The makato plugin marketplace — a curated suite of Claude Code plugins for software engineering workflows.

plugins.name: makato-core
plugins.description: Shared developer utilities and suite infrastructure for makato — codebase navigation, GitHub issue filing, and plugin discovery.

plugins.name: makato-doc
plugins.description: Documentation-authoring skills for the makato suite — library reference lookup (Context7), README crafting, markdown authoring/linting, and Strunk-style prose editing. Cross-cutting obligations for every code- and doc-producing agent.

plugins.name: makato-contribute
plugins.description: Contributor tools for the makato suite — scaffold plugins and skills and sync content from upstream repos, all validated against suite conventions.

plugins.name: makato-plan
plugins.description: Transforms raw feature requests into vertically-sliced GitHub issues through structured brainstorming, PRD, architecture, UX design, and decomposition with acceptance criteria.

plugins.name: makato-build
plugins.description: Transforms decomposed, vertically-sliced stories into tested, reviewed, merged code.

plugins.name: makato-orchestrate
plugins.description: Autonomous control plane (scaffold — not yet shipped) for driving GitHub Issues to merged PRs unattended, coordinating makato-plan and makato-build with workflow-state, kill-switch, and HALT-code dispatch.

plugins.name: makato-change
plugins.description: Implement changes to existing functionality based on updated business requirements.

plugins.name: makato-ux
plugins.description: Transform built code into a production UX platform.

plugins.name: makato-langgraph
plugins.description: LangGraph-specific reference skills and patterns for building Python AI agents (StateGraph, ReAct, human-in-the-loop, persistence, reflexion).

plugins.name: makato-database
plugins.description: Postgres performance optimization, query writing, schema design, and database administration best practices.

plugins.name: makato-sagibeast
plugins.description: Sagibeast (CMAI) platform skills — Word template schema extraction, PDF and Excel processing, testbox VM provisioning, and CMAI environment connectivity.

plugins.name: makato-observability
plugins.description: LLM-observability skills for tracing, monitoring, and debugging LangGraph-based AI agents — Langfuse-first via OpenTelemetry SDK + OTLP HTTP export. Vendor-neutral: no hosting-provider names in prose or templates.

plugins.name: makato-temporal
plugins.description: Provide Temporal durable-execution reference skills for building, debugging, and operating workflows, activities, and workers across Python, TypeScript, Java, and Rust SDKs.

plugins.name: makato-fastapi
plugins.description: Provide FastAPI-specific reference skills and conventions for building correct, production-ready Python HTTP APIs with the FastAPI framework.

plugins.name: makato-typesafeai
plugins.description: Provide reference skills and patterns for building AI-powered applications with TypeSafe's System One model API.
